dicethrone.title: Dice Throne
dicethrone.description: A fast-paced, easy-to-learn game where you choose the most extraordinary hero from many. Roll your hero's unique 5 dice to attack opponents and activate abilities. Accumulate combat points to purchase powerful cards—upgrade your hero, cast spells, or directly manipulate dice (yours, your teammates', or your opponents').

smashup.title: Smash Up
smashup.description: Smash Up is a 2-4 player card battle game! Combine two different factions to compete for base control and victory points; the first to 15 points wins. The base game includes 8 distinct factions, enabling many strategic pairings and playstyles. (Year: 2012; Type: Competitive/Card; Rating: 7.2)

testing.title: 🧪 Automated Testing + AI Audit — Five Parallel Tracks
testing.subtitle: Command-driven first · Entity integrity · Interaction integrity · E2E screenshots · AI logic audit · Click anywhere to go back
testing.summary_vitest: 🧪 Command-driven first: pure-function engine + deterministic pipeline → replay commands to verify rule correctness
testing.summary_integrity: 🔗 Entity integrity: registry + reference chain + trigger path + effect contracts → ensure definitions never break their links
testing.summary_interaction: 🎯 Interaction integrity: Mode A (UI state machine payload) + Mode B (handler registration chain) → ensure the interaction chain stays intact
testing.summary_e2e: 🌐 E2E screenshots: headless browser + pixel diff → prevent visual UI regressions
testing.summary_ai: 🤖 AI logic audit: eight-layer tracing + semantic consistency + metadata audit + role reversal + data-query consistency + 16 anti-pattern checks
testing.coverage_note: * Command-driven tests cover rule logic and state transitions · AI audit covers spec/implementation mismatches, query bypasses, and cross-effects · Other includes issues such as environment, concurrency, and performance that are harder to automate

story.title: 📖 User Story — 6 Phases to Create a New Game
story.subtitle: Based on the create-new-game skill, data entry is merged into one phase · each phase is independently verifiable · click anywhere to go back
story.workflow: 🎲 Workflow: skeleton → data entry (rules + entities + types) → domain core → system assembly → UI interaction → polish and release
story.principle: 💡 Core principle: each phase should be independently verifiable and committable → the game only answers four core questions and opts into base capabilities → the engine handles the rest
